title: kithctl bootstrap before SSE loop: prevents replay notification storm
description: The Message/get ids=[] bootstrap before the SSE reconnect loop is the correct design. Without it, last_message_state starts at s-0 and the first SSE event causes fetch_and_notify to replay every message ever received as a desktop notification. A future contributor may suggest lazily initializing the cursor to 's-0' to simplify startup — this would cause exactly that notification storm on every kithctl start. The bootstrap failure is also correctly fatal: failing over to s-0 would be worse than failing fast.
